name: L’Atelier Café
direction: A bright, warm neighborhood café: cream, coffee brown, caramel and clear Vietnamese typography.

principles: Match native and Ant Design controls
Do not style internal library inputs as standalone fields
Use coffee brown for primary actions and visible focus
Use dark text on caramel; never small caramel text on white

layout.customer: Responsive menu grid; persistent cart access; readable order and payment status.
layout.staff: Light navigation; cream workspace; compact POS with 320–380px ticket; independently scrollable work areas; tablet icon rail.
layout.admin: Light management workspace with task groups, scrollable data tables and no links into Staff operations.
layout.mobileNavigation: Scrollable navigation keeps all existing destinations accessible.

constraints: Preserve API contracts, authentication and role boundaries.
Keep workflow and financial state driven by server responses.
Do not invent business metrics for unfinished screens.
Maintain visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior.
